sources: ontology/spec/upstream/bundle (Argo CD v3.6.1, Flux helm v1.7.1, kustomize v1.10.1 CRDs)
scenario: the HelmRelease's upgrade of pricing to 1.5.0 timed out and was rolled back to 1.4.0, the version with the old behaviour
query: why is pricing still on the old behaviour in shop
mechanism: Released=False UpgradeFailed for 1.5.0, then Remediated RollbackSucceeded to 1.4.0
pass_if: names the HelmRelease's failed upgrade and rollback
partial_if_only: pricing runs 1.4.0, without the failed upgrade
chain: the HelmRelease attempted 1.5.0, failed and rolled back (history v5 failed, v6 deployed 1.4.0)
